questions.question: Which definition makes add(2, 3) type-check as number?
options: function add(a, b) { return a + b; } with no types in strict mode.
function add(a: number, b: number): number { return a + b; }
function add(a: number, b: number) return a + b;
const add(a: number, b: number) { return a + b; }
questions.explanation: Parameters need annotations in a standalone function. Braces and return are still JavaScript.
